workflow.name: Puber Release
workflow.description: Prepare the next Puber release, create the version bump PR, monitor CI, then publish the release tag after approval.

edges.prompt_template:
Run the Puber one-flow release process.

Read .kent/project-contract.md, .kent/commands/release-branch.md, .kent/commands/release-tag.md, and AGENTS.md first. Treat the task body as release intent. Default to next minor release from origin/master. Use patch only when explicitly requested; use major only when explicitly requested. If .kent/commands/release.md exists, use it as supplementary unified guidance, but do not block solely because that file is absent.

Fetch origin/master and tags, compute the target version, create or reuse release/<version>, update app/build.gradle.kts currentVersion, commit the bump, and verify with focused compile checks. If local release signing secrets are unavailable, record that production packaging could not be locally proven, but do not block the version-bump PR solely for missing local signing secrets. Do not create or push a release tag in this node.

Complete with compliance when the version bump branch is ready and provide release_version, release_type, release_branch, release_tag, workspace_path, version_bump_commit, and verification_summary. Complete with needs_user_action and provide blocker_reason if the release cannot be prepared safely.

Run mandatory Puber Compliance Review for the prepared release.

Read .kent/commands/compliance-review.md, .kent/project-contract.md, .kent/commands/release-branch.md, .kent/commands/release-tag.md, and AGENTS.md first. If .kent/commands/release.md exists, use it as supplementary unified guidance, but do not block solely because that file is absent. Reviewed scope: release {{.Params.release_version}} ({{.Params.release_type}}) on branch {{.Params.release_branch}} in workspace {{.Params.workspace_path}}, commit {{.Params.version_bump_commit}}, intended tag {{.Params.release_tag}}, verification {{.Params.verification_summary}}. Review only compliance with release rules, task requirements, AGENTS.md, and workflow contract. Do not edit files.

Complete with ship_pr and provide compliance_report when no compliance violations are found. Complete with needs_changes and provide workspace_path plus compliance_report when release preparation must be fixed. Complete with needs_user_action for temporary external waits; provide blocker_reason. Complete with needs_user_action only if required sources are contradictory or continuing would be unsafe; provide blocker_reason.

edges.prompt_template:
Resume this Puber workflow stage after a user-visible blocker was resolved or explicit permission was granted.

Read AGENTS.md, .kent/project-contract.md, the latest task comments, and the previous blocker reason: {{.Params.blocker_reason}}.

Do not restart from backlog, do not discard existing .todo/worktree/PR context, and do not broaden scope. Continue only within the current stage. If the blocker is still present, add or update a task comment with the exact next action, then complete with needs_user_action and provide blocker_reason again. Never use a terminal state for a recoverable blocker. If the task was explicitly canceled, use a close/no-PR path only when that transition exists and the latest user comment clearly asks for it.

Approval by itself is only permission to re-check this stage; it is not proof that the blocker was resolved. Before taking any non-wait transition, verify a new human task comment, task body update, or external proof that specifically resolves the previous blocker. If that proof is absent or the blocker still exists, add/update a task comment with the exact next action and complete with needs_user_action again, providing blocker_reason.

parameters.description: Short human-readable blocker explanation in the task language when practical; include the missing access/input/check and the exact next user action needed.

edges.prompt_template:
Create or update the Puber release version-bump PR.

Read .kent/project-contract.md, .kent/commands/ship-pr.md, .kent/commands/release-branch.md, .kent/commands/release-tag.md, and AGENTS.md first. If .kent/commands/release.md exists, use it as supplementary unified guidance, but do not block solely because that file is absent. Compliance result: {{.Params.compliance_report}}. Release context from preparation: version {{.Params.prepare_compliance.release_version}}, type {{.Params.prepare_compliance.release_type}}, branch {{.Params.prepare_compliance.release_branch}}, tag {{.Params.prepare_compliance.release_tag}}, workspace {{.Params.prepare_compliance.workspace_path}}.

Commit only release-task changes if anything remains uncommitted, push {{.Params.prepare_compliance.release_branch}} to origin, and create or update a GitHub PR for the version bump. Do not merge the PR. Do not push directly to master. Do not create or push a release tag in this node.

Complete with monitor_ci when a PR exists and provide pr_url, branch_name, workspace_path, release_version, and release_tag. Complete with needs_changes when PR creation/update is needs_user_action by recoverable branch, rebase, conflict, push, or PR metadata state; provide workspace_path, release_version, release_type, release_branch, release_tag, and blocker_reason. Complete with needs_user_action only if PR creation/update cannot continue safely without changing release scope, credentials, or project policy; provide blocker_reason.

Fix Puber release preparation compliance violations only.

Read .kent/project-contract.md, .kent/commands/release-branch.md, .kent/commands/release-tag.md, and .kent/commands/compliance-review.md first. If .kent/commands/release.md exists, use it as supplementary unified guidance, but do not block solely because that file is absent. Apply only the minimum changes required by {{.Params.compliance_report}} in workspace {{.Params.workspace_path}}. Verify narrowly, then complete with compliance and provide release_version, release_type, release_branch, release_tag, workspace_path, version_bump_commit, and verification_summary. Complete with needs_user_action and provide blocker_reason if unsafe or missing input.

edges.prompt_template:
Monitor the Puber release PR checks.

Read .kent/project-contract.md, .kent/commands/release-branch.md,
.kent/commands/release-tag.md, and .kent/commands/release.md first. Inspect PR
{{.Params.pr_url}} for release {{.Params.release_version}} / tag
{{.Params.release_tag}} on branch {{.Params.branch_name}}. Do not merge the PR
and do not push commits from this node.

Resolve the exact PR once. Pending, queued, and in-progress checks are not a
workflow transition and never require user approval. Wait in one shell command:

`gh pr checks {{.Params.pr_url}} --watch --interval 30`

After the watcher exits, re-read authoritative PR/check state. Complete with
`ci_monitor_waiting_pr` only when required checks are green or intentionally absent;
provide pr_url, release_version, release_tag, branch_name, workspace_path, and
ci_report. Complete with `ci_monitor_needs_changes` only for a task-scoped release failure
and provide workspace_path plus ci_report. Use `ci_monitor_needs_user_action` only for
authentication/access, ambiguous PR identity, contradictory policy, or another
actual human decision. Never use it merely because checks are still running.

edges.prompt_template:
Hold this Puber release until the release pull request is actually merged.

Read AGENTS.md, .kent/project-contract.md, the latest task comments, release PR {{.Params.pr_url}}, branch {{.Params.branch_name}}, release version {{.Params.release_version}}, release tag {{.Params.release_tag}}, workspace {{.Params.workspace_path}}, and CI report {{.Params.ci_report}}.

Use `gh pr view --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit,headRefName,baseRefName,url` when available. Do not merge the PR. Do not create or push the release tag from this node. Do not clean up while the PR is still open.

Complete with pr_merged only when GitHub reports state=MERGED; provide pr_url, branch_name, release_version, release_tag, workspace_path, and merge_report. Complete with needs_changes when release PR review comments, merge conflicts, or post-CI regressions can be fixed within release-preparation scope; provide workspace_path, release_version, release_tag, and pr_report. Complete with needs_user_action when the PR is still open, waiting for human review/approval/merge, or needs_user_action by an external process; add a task comment with the current PR status and exact human action, then provide pr_url, branch_name, release_version, release_tag, workspace_path, and waiting_reason. Complete with close_without_merge only if the latest user comment explicitly says to cancel this release PR; provide pr_url, branch_name, workspace_path, and cleanup_reason.

edges.prompt_template:
Monitor Puber release automation after tag publication.

Read .kent/project-contract.md, .kent/commands/release.md, and
.kent/commands/release-tag.md first. Release: {{.Params.release_tag}} at
{{.Params.target_commit}}. Prepared Russian notes:
{{.Params.release_notes_path}}.

Resolve the exact GitHub Actions run from the tag and target commit. Pending,
queued, and in-progress state is not a workflow transition and never requires
user approval. Wait in one shell command:

`gh run watch <run-id> --exit-status --interval 30`

After the watcher exits, re-read authoritative run/job state. On success,
verify that the GitHub Release exists, apply the prepared notes with
`gh release edit {{.Params.release_tag}} --notes-file
{{.Params.release_notes_path}}`, then read the release back and verify its body
is non-empty Russian text. Complete with `monitor_release_published` only after both
automation and release-notes verification pass; provide release_report with the
run, jobs, release URL, and notes evidence.

Use `monitor_needs_user_action` only for terminal automation failure,
authentication/access, ambiguous run identity, missing release/notes artifact,
or contradictory policy. Never use it merely because automation is still
running.

edges.prompt_template:
Publish the approved Puber release after the release PR was confirmed merged.

Read AGENTS.md, .kent/project-contract.md, .kent/commands/release.md,
.kent/commands/release-tag.md, latest task comments, release version
{{.Params.release_version}}, release tag {{.Params.release_tag}}, PR
{{.Params.pr_url}}, workspace {{.Params.workspace_path}}, and merge report
{{.Params.merge_report}}. This transition is intentionally approval-gated.

Before tagging, verify the PR is still MERGED and resolve the immutable target
commit plus previous release tag. Summarize the delivered range as concise
user-facing release notes in Russian. Exclude the version-bump PR and internal
release chores; rewrite technical titles as user-visible changes. Save the
non-empty notes under the ignored task workspace at
`.todo/{{.TaskShortId}}/release-notes-ru.md`.

Verify the release tag does not point to a conflicting commit, then create and
push it. Complete with `publish_monitor` and provide release_version, release_tag,
target_commit, pr_url, tag_push_status, and release_notes_path. Use
`publish_needs_user_action` only for conflicting tag/target evidence, missing
authorization, authentication/access, or another actual human decision.
